experiments.label: M7
experiments.title: Training-bank controls and aligned future supervision
experiments.hypothesis: Aligning auxiliary targets to the forecast horizon may improve trajectory and event skill without new predictors.
experiments.method: Four training-side CV splits; retrain both prior controls. Four controlled future-supervision losses with identical data, architecture, seeds and fixed epochs.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on all four training-side metrics: at least 1% RMSE reduction, +0.005 Fisher r, 0.5% chi-square reduction, and +0.02 HSE threat score.
experiments.observation: Original hashes verified; Fold5 was discarded without parsing or retention. Training-bank baselines are running.
